metadata.name: dev-flow
metadata.description: Software development main flow: Triage → Branch by task_type → Feature/Bugfix/Hotfix/Analysis/Change → Terminal
metadata.author: team-flow
metadata.notes: Node IDs use short keys (tri3, ent7, etc.) for internal routing uniqueness. Node names are the human-readable display labels. sf-* subflow nodes route to: feature-flow, bugfix-flow, hotfix-flow, analysis-flow, change-flow. batch-flow and release-flow are independent flows and are NOT routed through dev-flow sf-* subflows.

skills.name: API Design
skills.description: Design RESTful/gRPC API contracts with consistent naming and error handling

skills.name: Protobuf
skills.description: Protocol Buffer schema design and code generation

nodes.name: Session Start
nodes.description: 理解用户意图，确定任务范围。此阶段不创建 Task，产出 CONTEXT.md。

docs.name: CONTEXT.md
docs.description: 需求初步理解：用户意图摘要、任务类型初步判断（feature|bug|hotfix|analysis|change）、需要澄清的问题

nodes.name: Task Triage
nodes.description: 分类任务类型、评估范围和优先级，创建 Task 并确定分发分支。基于 CONTEXT.md 做正式分类。

docs.name: TRIAGE.md
docs.description: 分类记录：task_type(feature|bug|hotfix|analysis|change)、priority(high|medium|low)、scope assessment

nodes.name: Entry Gate
nodes.description: 验证任务分类产出完整，满足进入执行分支的条件

conditions.check: 检查本地任务文件 .team/tasks/{task_id}.json 存在
检查 TRIAGE.md 存在且非空
TRIAGE.md 中声明的 task_type 是有效值(feature|bug|hotfix|analysis|change)

nodes.name: Requirements Analysis
nodes.description: Analyze feature requirements and produce specification with acceptance criteria

docs.name: Design Checklist
docs.description: Mandatory v3-Asset checklist for feature design quality

docs.name: ARCHITECTURE.md
docs.description: [PRE-READ] Project system architecture: module structure, data flow, external dependencies. Understand before writing any design/spec
content_rules: READ-ONLY: Do not modify. Understand the layered architecture (cmd→internal→data→infra)
Verify: your design respects existing module boundaries
If change requires architecture modification: update this doc FIRST, then proceed

docs.name: DESIGN.md
docs.description: [PRE-READ] Design principles: pure-function-first, defensive design, explicit-over-implicit. Every design decision must follow these principles
content_rules: READ-ONLY: Do not modify. Use as the rule book for design decisions
If your change violates a principle: the principle must be updated before the change
Check: Does new logic go into pure functions? Are side effects isolated at edges?

docs.name: CONSENSUS.md
docs.description: [PRE-READ] Project consensus decisions: task-ID format (team-flow-xxx), v2/v3 separation, test requirements, document-before-code policy
content_rules: READ-ONLY: Do not modify. Consensus changes require team-level process
Verify: any task IDs you create follow beads format
Verify: any document references point to v3 paths

docs.name: STANDARDS.md
docs.description: [PRE-READ] Coding and testing standards: test-driven, error handling, naming conventions, git/commit format
content_rules: READ-ONLY: Do not modify. Use as the standard for code review
All implementation must follow Go standards: explicit error returns, meaningful names
All public functions must have doc comments

docs.name: SPEC.md
docs.description: Feature specification: requirements, scope, constraints, data models, API contracts, user journey, navigation, interaction flows
content_rules: Must contain: overview, requirements, constraints, dependencies
Must contain: reference to relevant section in ARCHITECTURE.md (which modules are affected)
Must contain: design rationale against DESIGN.md principles
Must contain: user-facing pages with routes, layouts, and component specs (not admin-only)
Must contain: navigation entry points — how users reach each page from existing UI
Must contain: interaction flows for key scenarios (subscribe, upgrade, cancel, etc.) with step-by-step UI transitions
Must contain: state-to-UI mapping — what users see for each business state (active, past_due, expired, etc.)
Must contain: empty/loading/error states for each user-facing page

docs.name: AC.md
docs.description: Acceptance criteria: measurable conditions for feature completion with Given-When-Then format, including UI and navigation criteria
content_rules: Must contain: acceptance criteria as testable assertions
Each criterion must be verifiable (pass/fail)
Must contain: UI-level acceptance criteria — what user sees and can interact with, not just API responses
Must contain: navigation reachability criteria — every page must be reachable from at least one navigation entry
Must contain: end-to-end user journey criteria — user can complete key flows without dead ends

nodes.name: Technical Design
nodes.description: Design data models, state machines, and API contracts based on requirements

docs.name: R1_DATA_MODEL.md
docs.description: Data model design: entity relationships, schema definitions, index strategy

docs.name: R2_STATE_MACHINE.md
docs.description: State machine design: transitions, events, lifecycle, error states

docs.name: R3_API_CONTRACT.md
docs.description: API contract: endpoints, request/response schemas, error codes, versioning

docs.name: R4_UI_SPEC.md
docs.description: UI specification: frontend routes, navigation, component specs, interaction flows, state-to-UI mapping
content_rules: Must contain: frontend route definitions for ALL user-facing pages (not admin-only)
Must contain: navigation structure — sidebar/menu items, entry points, breadcrumbs
Must contain: component specs per page — which UI components, form fields, action buttons
Must contain: interaction flow diagrams — step-by-step UI transitions for key scenarios
Must contain: state-to-UI mapping table — business state → displayed UI elements
Must contain: empty state, loading state, error state for each page

nodes.name: Implementation
nodes.description: Implement the feature code and unit tests following the technical design

docs.name: ARCHITECTURE.md
docs.description: [PRE-READ] Understand module structure and data flow BEFORE implementing. Verify that your implementation respects existing boundaries (cmd → internal/flow → internal/proc → internal/bd).
content_rules: Map your implementation to module(s). What layer does each change touch?
If your change requires a new module boundary or new external CLI → UPDATE ARCHITECTURE.md first, then implement
Verify: no circular dependencies between modules

docs.name: DESIGN.md
docs.description: [PRE-READ] Check design principles: pure-function-first, defensive design, explicit-over-implicit, single responsibility.
content_rules: Logic core must be in pure functions (no I/O, no global state)
Side effects (file read/write, exec.Command) must be isolated at the EDGE of the module
Pure functions MUST have unit tests

docs.name: CONSENSUS.md
docs.description: [PRE-READ] Check consensus: task ID format (team-flow-xxx via beads), v3-only paths, flow-driven (not ad-hoc) execution.
content_rules: NEVER generate task IDs by hand or with random ID generators — always go through bd.CreateIssue()
Do not bypass v3 flow: if there is no flow for your operation, propose adding one, do not just code it

docs.name: STANDARDS.md
docs.description: [PRE-READ] Coding/testing standards to follow during implementation.
content_rules: TDD Red-Green-Refactor: write failing test → make it pass → clean up
Every exported function MUST have a doc comment
Error wrapping: fmt.Errorf("context: %w", err)
Commit format: feat|fix({module}): {description}

docs.name: IMPL.md
docs.description: Implementation notes: key code changes, architectural decisions, test coverage summary
content_rules: Must contain: list of files changed, purpose of each change
Must reference: which ARCHITECTURE.md modules are affected
Must reference: which DESIGN.md principles guided the change
Must document: test coverage (unit test names, what they cover)
Must have: verification commands (actual CLI commands to run tests + E2E check)

nodes.name: Root Cause Investigation
nodes.description: Investigate the bug, identify root cause, and produce RCA document

docs.name: ARCHITECTURE.md
docs.description: [PRE-READ] Before investigating: map the bug to its module in the architecture. Which module(s) does it touch? Where is the boundary it crosses?
content_rules: Map the bug to the module structure (cmd/flow → internal/flow → internal/proc → bd/ etc.)
Identify which architecture assumption is broken (e.g., stdout-only assumption, pure-function assumption)

docs.name: DESIGN.md
docs.description: [PRE-READ] Identify which design principle the bug violates. Did the original code fail to follow defensive design? Pure-function-first? Explicit-over-implicit?
content_rules: State the principle that was violated
This is the baseline your fix must restore — your fix must re-align with these principles

docs.name: CONSENSUS.md
docs.description: [PRE-READ] Verify no consensus-violation in the bug. E.g., did code bypass bd.CreateIssue and generate IDs directly?
content_rules: READ-ONLY. Check: is the bug a consensus-violation (wrong task ID format, bypassing tools)?

docs.name: STANDARDS.md
docs.description: [PRE-READ] Understand testing standards: the fix needs unit tests + integration tests, matching the test level required
content_rules: What test level does this bug require? Unit for pure functions, integration for module interactions, E2E for CLI paths
Use the test templates from this document when writing regression tests

docs.name: RCA.md
docs.description: Root cause analysis: bug origin, affected components, reproduction steps, severity assessment
content_rules: Must contain: phenomenon, root_cause, impact, prevention
Must reference: which ARCHITECTURE.md module is affected
Must reference: which DESIGN.md principle is violated
Must reference: which CONSENSUS.md decision is violated (if any)
Data flow trace required for API/permission/state bugs
Real scenario verification required (not mock-only)

nodes.name: Bug Fix
nodes.description: Implement the bug fix and add regression tests

docs.name: ARCHITECTURE.md
docs.description: [PRE-READ] Must understand module boundaries BEFORE making code changes. Verify which modules are affected.
content_rules: Before touching code: map the fix to module(s). What layer? cmd/flow? internal/proc? internal/bd?
After the fix: if the fix changes architecture (module boundary or flow), UPDATE this document to reflect the change
If your fix introduces a new module or a new external CLI dependency: UPDATE ARCHITECTURE.md — the document must change before the code

docs.name: DESIGN.md
docs.description: [PRE-READ] Design principles: pure-function-first, defensive design, explicit-over-implicit. The fix must follow these.
content_rules: Core logic must be in pure functions. Side effects at edges
If parsing or validation logic: MUST be a pure function with unit tests
The fix should make things more consistent, not introduce new patterns

docs.name: CONSENSUS.md
docs.description: [PRE-READ] Confirm the fix respects consensus: task-ID format (team-flow-xxx), v2/v3 separation, flow-driven execution.
content_rules: Do not bypass tools: use bd.CreateIssue() for task IDs, not hand-rolled ID generators
Do not hard-code paths. Use config paths from project.md
Flow-driven: if this fix needs to become a new rule, propose a consensus update

docs.name: STANDARDS.md
docs.description: [PRE-READ] Coding standards, testing standards, commit format. Every code change must match these.
content_rules: Write tests FIRST (TDD Red-Green-Refactor)
Pure functions MUST have unit tests
Public functions MUST have doc comments
Commit messages follow: fix({module}): {description}
Never commit lint warnings

docs.name: FIX.md
docs.description: Bug fix notes: fix approach, code changes, regression test additions, verification steps
content_rules: Must contain: files modified, functions changed, rationale against DESIGN.md principles
Must reference: ARCHITECTURE.md modules involved
Must reference: CONSENSUS.md decisions respected (or violated, with explanation)
Must contain: new tests added (unit test names and what they cover)
Must contain: end-to-end verification steps (CLI commands + expected output)

nodes.name: Emergency Fix
nodes.description: Implement the emergency hotfix with minimal scope

docs.name: RCA.md
docs.description: Emergency RCA: incident timeline, root cause, fix description, post-incident actions
content_rules: Must contain: phenomenon, root_cause, impact, prevention
Data flow trace required for API/permission/state bugs
Real scenario verification required (not mock-only)

nodes.name: Analysis Subflow
nodes.description: Invoke analysis-flow for deep technical analysis

nodes.name: Deep Analysis
nodes.description: Perform technical analysis and gather findings

docs.name: FINDINGS.md
docs.description: Analysis findings: investigation results, evidence, patterns, technical insights

nodes.name: Analysis Report
nodes.description: Compile analysis results into a structured report with conclusions

docs.name: REPORT.md
docs.description: Final analysis report: conclusions, recommendations, action items, risk assessment

nodes.name: Change Planning
nodes.description: Plan the change scope, impact analysis, and migration strategy

docs.name: SCOPE.md
docs.description: Change scope: what will be modified, added, or removed, with dependency map
content_rules: Must contain: changed files, added files, deleted files, risk assessment

docs.name: IMPACT.md
docs.description: Impact analysis: affected components, dependencies, migration steps, rollback plan

nodes.name: Change Execution
nodes.description: Execute the planned changes and update tests

docs.name: EXEC.md
docs.description: Change execution notes: modifications made, files affected, test updates, verification steps

nodes.name: Quality Gate
nodes.description: Verify code quality: tests pass, lint clean, no regressions, AND document consistency

docs.name: Quality Gates Checklist
docs.description: Mandatory QG-1 to QG-4 checks for quality gate approval

docs.name: Traceability Matrix
docs.description: Mandatory proof of requirement alignment between code and SPEC

conditions.check: All unit and integration tests pass
No lint errors in changed files

conditions.details: ARCHITECTURE.md, DESIGN.md, CONSENSUS.md, STANDARDS.md were loaded and their rules respected
SPEC.md/RCA.md/FIX.md/IMPL.md must reference relevant sections in ARCHITECTURE.md + DESIGN.md + CONSENSUS.md

conditions.check: No code change without corresponding doc update when design changes
conditions.details: If code introduces new modules/breaks a design principle: the core docs must be updated BEFORE the code change

nodes.name: Integration Verification
nodes.description: Run full integration and E2E tests, verify completeness

docs.name: TEST_COVERAGE.md
docs.description: Test coverage report: unit, integration, and E2E test results with coverage metrics

nodes.name: Code Review
nodes.description: Review code quality, architecture compliance, and produce completion scope

docs.name: SCOPE.md
docs.description: Completion scope: what was implemented, changed, known issues, and verification notes
content_rules: Must contain: changed files, added files, deleted files, risk assessment

nodes.name: Plan Approval Gate
nodes.description: 方案审核确认：验证方案完整性、用户确认、资源准备情况，确保方案准备就绪后再执行

conditions.check: 方案文档已完成并包含必要内容
资源和依赖已准备就绪
风险评估和回滚方案已制定

docs.name: 方案确认清单
docs.description: 方案审核确认清单：方案内容、用户确认、资源准备、风险评估
